'''Varrock''' ([[rsw:Transcript:Pronunciation guide|Jagex pronunciation]]: {{respell|vah|ROCK}}) is the [[capital]] of the kingdom of [[Misthalin]]. It is one of the largest cities in ''[[Old School RuneScape]]'', and the largest city available to [[free player]]s. In addition to being popular due to its proximity to the [[Wilderness]], the city hosts the massive [[Grand Exchange]], through which players can trade any item they wish, and features in many of the [[quests]] throughout the game.

Varrock can be entered from all sides, and each entrance has non-[[aggressive]] level 21 [[guard]]s surrounding it. The city is safe for all players, although care should be taken when coming from [[Lumbridge]] through the south entrance, as there are aggressive level 7 and 20 [[dark wizard]]s.

{{ToC|limit=2}}

==History==
Prior to holding its current name, the city was known as [[Avarrocka]], and came into being in the year 700 of the [[Fourth Age]]. During this time, the races that had survived the [[God Wars]] began to compete for land without the direct aid of [[gods]], and most of humanity lived in small nomadic tribes. One of these tribes, looking to settle in the forest, discovered a young boy during their travels who was about two years of age. The boy stood nearly a foot taller than most his age, and was already quite strong; the wanderers, taking the boy's strength as a good omen, chose that place to made a camp.

Ten years since the initial settlement, the baby remained unnamed, and the [[Elders of Avarrocka|elders]] decided to send the child on a quest to find one. The child eventually stumbled upon a tribe of [[goblins]] that planned to attack the settlement. When the goblins saw him, they attacked, screaming "''arrav''," a word from their language. The goblins were defeated by the boy, who returned to Avarrocka and recounted the tale, and was thenceforth known as "''Arrav''". As [[Arrav]] grew, so did Avarrocka; this caused [[Zemouregal]], a powerful [[Zamorakian]] [[Mahjarrat]] [[Necromancy|necromancer]], to set his sights on the city.

Attempting to ward off Zemouregal, Arrav sought out [[Shield of arrav (item)|a mythical shield]]. During his journey to find this shield, he travelled across the realm, but upon his return, he found Avarrocka burned to the ground. However, the city was able to rebuild. About a century into Avarrocka's existence, however, Zemouregal [[Invasion of Avarrocka|invaded]] with an army of zombies. While his army was slain, the battle cost Arrav his life, and Zemouregal retreated with a now-undead Arrav. Shortly after, the people of Avarrocka began expanding, eventually forming the first human nation, [[Misthalin]], and later becoming a monarchy.

As centuries passed, creatures from [[Morytania]] attacked Misthalin. In a great battle, [[Seven Priestly Warriors|seven priestly warriors]] eventually defeated them and blessed the [[River Salve]], making it impassable to creatures following Zamorak. Not all was peaceful for Varrock, however; the fabled shield that Arrav used to save the city was eventually stolen by the notorious [[Phoenix Gang]], who would [[Black Arm Gang|later split in two]], with the Phoenix gang [[Phoenix Gang Hideout|taking over much of the residential district]] of the city, and the Black Arm Gang [[Black Arm Gang Headquarters|hiding in the city's industrial section]]. An [[Player character|adventurer]] was eventually able to retrieve the shield and later on during [[Defender of Varrock|Zemouregal's second attempt]] at attacking the city, they were able to find a descendant of the Elders of Avarrocka, [[Dimintheis Fitzharmon]], who was able to use its powers to defeat Zemouregal's undead army.

It is not exactly known when Avarrocka was renamed to Varrock. Some, such as the barbarians, still call it Avarrocka; other languages have their own name for the city, such as the [[Gnome (race)|gnomes]], who refer to it as Lemanto Andra ("Man City").

==Transportation==
*Players with level 25 [[Magic]] can cast [[Varrock Teleport]].
*The [[balloon transport system]] has a stop south of the [[Lumber Yard]].
*There is also a [[spirit tree]] to the [[Grand Exchange]], and a [[fairy ring]] just north-west of Varrock, using the code {{fairycode|DKR}}.
*The [[canoe]] transport system also has three landing points near Varrock, stopping at the [[Champions' Guild]], and the bridges to [[Barbarian Village]] and [[Edgeville]].
*Players can use a charged [[combat bracelet]] or buy a [[Chronicle]] and [[teleport card]]s from [[Diango's Toy Store]] to teleport to the [[Champions' Guild]], south-west of the Varrock south gate.
*The [[skills necklace]] can be used to teleport to the [[Cooks' Guild]] just west of the Grand Exchange.
*The [[ring of wealth]] can be used to teleport to the Grand Exchange.
*The [[ring of the elements]] can be used to teleport near to the [[Earth Altar]] entrance found north-east of Varrock.
*The [[Quetzal Transport System]] offers a stop east of the [[tea stall]] and across the Varrock wall after completing [[Twilight's Promise]].
*The [[diary cape]] can be used to teleport to [[Toby]] for players who have completed all [[Achievement Diary|achievement diaries]].
[[File:Varrock east entrance.png|thumb|Varrock east entrance.]]

==Locations==
===Stores===
[[File:Cryptic clue - talk apothecary varrock.png|thumb|The Varrock Apothecary]]
Varrock has many stores, most of which are located in or around [[Varrock Square]]:

* [[Aubury's Rune Shop]] — a store selling most types of [[runes]]. Players can also speak to [[Aubury]] here to be teleported to the [[Rune Essence mine]].
* [[Fur stall|Baraek's fur stall]] — a stall ran by [[Baraek]], the [[fur trader]] in [[Varrock Square]].
* [[Estate Agent]] — an agent who offers [[player-owned house]] services such as relocation and redecoration, and can sell players their house.
* [[Fancy Clothes Store]] — another clothes shop, found in the south-eastern part of the city. This store features heavily in the [[Hunter]] skill, and it is here that furs can be made into camouflage and other [[hunter armour]].
* Hairdresser's — [[Emma]] and [[Suzie]]'s hairdresser salon ([[File:Hairdresser icon.png]]) can be found north of the museum. Accessing the [[makeover]] interface at the hairdresser is free of charge.
* [[Horvik's Armour Shop]] — a store where players can buy [[platebodies]] and [[chainbodies]] as well as [[platelegs]] and some [[leather armour]].
* [[Lowe's Archery Emporium]] — a store which sells items for the [[Ranging]] skill, such as [[bow]]s, [[crossbow (weapon)|crossbows]], and their corresponding [[ammunition]].
* [[Speedrunning Reward Shop]] — a stall run by [[Eliza]], who sells rewards in exchange for points from [[Quest Speedrunning]].
* [[Thessalia's Fine Clothes]] — a store selling [[robes]], [[cape]]s, [[gloves]], and [[boots]]. [[Thessalia]] will also change a player's appearance for free. Players who have lost their [[Scythe (Halloween event)|scythe]] or [[bunny ears]] may reclaim it from here if lost. [[Frog token]]s from the [[frog]] random event can also be exchanged for either a [[frog mask]], a [[royal frog costume]], or a [[lamp]] at this shop.
* [[Apothecary|Varrock Apothecary]] — home of a scientist who makes [[strength potions]] and [[energy potions]] for free-to-play players with the proper ingredients.
* [[Varrock General Store]] — one of the most popular stores in the game. New players can buy a [[newcomer map]] here, which can help them find their way around the [[Asgarnia]] and [[Misthalin]]. Players can sell whatever they wish to the store, but it's typically filled with low-level items. It's often hard to sell items to this general store as many people sell their items here, causing the store's inventory limit to be reached very easily.
* [[Varrock Herald]] stand — source for the newspaper of Varrock, sold by [[Benny]] for 50 coins.
* [[Varrock Swordshop]] — a place for players to buy [[bronze dagger|bronze]], [[iron dagger|iron]], [[steel dagger|steel]], [[black dagger|black]], [[mithril dagger|mithril]] and [[adamant dagger|adamant]] [[dagger]]s, [[sword]]s and [[longsword]]s.
* [[Ye olde Tea Shoppe.|Ye olde Tea Shoppe]] — a small stall where the [[Tea Seller|tea seller]] sells [[tea]] for 10 coins.
* [[Zaff's Superior Staffs]] — a store where players can purchase staves for [[Magic]]. He also sells [[battlestaves]] for use in the [[Crafting]] skill to players who have completed [[What Lies Below]], and additional battlestaves upon completion of the [[Varrock Diary|Varrock Diaries]].
[[File:Blue Moon Inn.png|thumb|Patrons in the [[Blue Moon Inn]].]]

===Pubs===
Varrock and the surrounding area has four pubs. Most Varrockian pubs sell only [[beer]], but the Rat Pit Bar also sells [[stew]].

* [[Blue Moon Inn]] — the most popular pub in Varrock. A couple NPCs reside here besides the bartender, which include an unnamed barbarian warrior, the ex-vampyre Slayer master [[Dr Harlow]], a tramp in the back room of the store, and [[Johnny the Beard]].
* [[Dancing Donkey Inn]] — a bar unknown to most of Varrock because it's found in the corner of the city. Whilst there, players may stumble upon the three drunken NPCs: [[Hops (Biohazard)|Hops]], too drunken to speak, [[Da Vinci]], who hates [[free player]]s, and [[Chancy]], who loves to gamble.
* [[Jolly Boar Inn]] — a large inn outside the city walls. The inn hosts the very tired [[Johnathon]], involved in the [[Family Crest]] quest. There are a lot of other NPCs here, including one woman, two men, and a [[Black Knight|black knight]].
* [[Ratpit bar (Varrock)|Ratpit Bar]] — a very little known pub can be found down the [[manhole (Rat Pits)|manhole]] in south-east Varrock, in the area that is cordoned off. It is very small and is mostly occupied with gamblers taking a break from the [[Rat Pits]] mini-game.
[[File:Varrock East bank.png|thumb|The Varrock east bank]]

===Banks===
Varrock has two banks, located near the east and west gates. The [[Varrock west bank]], a large bank just south of the [[Grand Exchange]], is frequently used by players training Smithing on the nearby [[anvil]]. There is also the [[Varrock east bank]], a small, two-story bank found south of the [[Varrock Museum]].
[[File:Leptoc mansion (2007).png|thumb|The massive house of the Leptocs]]

===Residential and community buildings===

* [[Aris]]' tent, the tent of Aris Maye, a fortune-teller who [[Demon Slayer|sees the player's future as a defender of Varrock]].
* [[Champions' Guild]], a prestigious guild offering tough battles, [[rune weapons]] and [[green dragonhide armour]], and intense [[quests]].
* [[Cooks' Guild]], a guild for master chefs, requiring 32 [[Cooking]] to enter. The guild also offers a [[Pie Shop|pie shop]] and a [[hopper]] for grinding [[wheat]] from the nearby field.
* [[Gertrude]]'s house, the well-kept house of Gertrude, a busy mother with four sons and lots of cats.
* Leptoc Mansion, a large mansion where [[Juliet|Juliet Leptoc]] resides, admired from afar by [[Romeo]].
* Training house, an open building immediately north of the east bank with attackable [[Dummy|dummies]]. Players can train up to level 8 [[Attack]] here.
* [[Rat Pits|Varrock Rat Pits]], an area where players can sic their cat on the invasive rats living below the city.
[[File:Fountain (Varrock).png|thumb|Varrock's east fountain.]]

===Resources and utilities===

* [[Altar]]s: Varrock has a total of three [[altar]]s within its walls, the [[Varrock Palace]] [[altar]], located on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}} of the palace, toward the rear, the [[Varrock chapel]] altar located in the [[chapel]] in the north-east corner of the city, and the [[Chaos_altar_(Prayer)#Varrock|chaos altar]] located in the [[Zamorakian Chapel]] south of [[Aubury's Rune Shop]].
* [[Anvil]]s: Varrock has three anvils, south of the west bank (popular for Smithing training due to its proximity to the bank), north-west of the east bank in [[Horvik's Armour Shop]], and south of the east bank
* [[Farming patches]]: there is a [[bush patch]] near the Champion's Guild, and a [[tree patch]] in Varrock Castle courtyard.
* [[Range]]s: many ranges are found in small houses all over Varrock.
* [[Tree]]s: inside the city are four [[yew tree]]s, and to the south of the city are some [[willow tree|willow]] and [[oak tree]]s. To the east of the city are some more yew trees.
* [[Water sources]]: players can obtain water from sinks in the [[Varrock Palace|castle]] and in fountains outside the castle and near the east bank.

===Skill training areas===
Players looking to train the Mining skill will find [[tin]], [[copper]], and [[iron]] rocks in the [[south-east Varrock mine]] south-east of the city, and will find [[clay]], [[tin]], [[silver]], and [[iron]] rocks in the [[south-west Varrock mine]] near the  [[Champion's Guild]]. The city also contains the [[Varrock Rooftop Course]], which requires level 30 [[Agility]] to traverse, starts at the [[Rough wall (Varrock Rooftop Course)|rough wall]] behind the general store, and ends behind the archery shop.
[[File:Varrock Museum second floor.png|thumb|Displays at the Varrock Museum.]]

===Varrock Museum===
{{Main|Varrock Museum}}
The Varrock Museum plays a role in and after many quests. Players earn kudos after quest completion, and can take the [[natural history quiz]] in the basement section of the museum. Players who have completed Bone Voyage may also bring fossils to the museum to complete displays for further rewards.

===Grand Exchange===
{{Main|Grand Exchange}}
The Grand Exchange is a massive trading system for players to purchase and sell tradeable items in ''[[Old School RuneScape]]''. Using the Grand Exchange replaced the [[trading post]] and the older marketplaces in Varrock and [[Falador]], because traders do not need to advertise, meet each other, or even wait at the Grand Exchange for trades to finish. [[Coins]] and items from fully and partially finished trades can be collected at any [[bank]] or [[deposit box]]. Additionally, players will receive a message in their chatbox when the status of a trade offer is updated.

===Varrock Palace===
{{Main|Varrock Palace}}
[[File:Varrock Palace.png|thumb|Varrock Palace]]
The [[Varrock Palace]] is the focus of many [[quests]], and features a number of different spots such as the queen's garden, the [[Varrock Library]] and the barracks for the Varrock guards. There is alsosingle [[monk of Zamorak]] found trapped in a cage near the palace entrance, making him great for safe magic and ranged training, and [[yew trees]] and a [[tree patch]] can be found within the castle walls.

In the [[Demon Slayer]] quest, there is a drain on the north-east part of the palace. Inside, there is a key to retrieve. To get it, players must pour water down the drain by getting a [[bucket]] (there is one conveniently located near the stairs that leads into the kitchen on the {{FloorNumber|uk=1}}), filling the bucket with water, and pouring the water down the drain. The key will then slosh down to the [[Varrock Sewers]], which is on the east side of the palace.
[[File:Fighting Scurrius.png|thumb|The rat boss Scurrius, found in the Varrock Sewers.]]

===Varrock Sewers===
{{Main|Varrock Sewers}}
Underneath the palace are the Varrock Sewers, a large sewer system that hosts monsters and bosses such as [[Scurrius]] and [[Bryophyta]].
[[File:Demon Slayer.png|thumb|The stone circle outside of Varrock, once dedicated to [[Guthix]] but now taken over by zealots.]]

===Outside city walls===
Several major locations exist within Varrock's vicinity, but outside the city's walls:

* [[Digsite]] — an archaeological excavation area just east of the gates marking Varrock's city limits. Players need to proceed far enough into [[The Dig Site]] quest in order to fully use it.
* Edgeville dungeon shed — a shed leading to the [[Edgeville Dungeon]]. Players must obtain the [[brass key]] to open it.
* [[Lumberyard]] — a [[sawmill]] that allows players to turn [[logs]] into [[planks]].
* [[South Varrock farm]] — a large [[list of farms|farm]] just south of Varrock's walls.
* [[Stone circle]] — a stone circle near the eastern entrance to the city featuring many dangerous level 20 and level 7 [[dark wizard]]s. This is where [[Delrith]] is summoned during the [[Demon Slayer]] quest.
* [[Tolna's rift|Tolna's Rift]] — a dungeon just outside of Varrock's city limits where a young boy's terrified mind manifested some strange and deadly monsters.
* [[Tunnel of Chaos]] — a safe shortcut to the [[Chaos Altar]] that's found in the [[Wilderness]].
* [[Paterdomus Temple]] — an ancient temple in [[Silvarea]] protecting the [[River Salve]]. The temple is owned by [[Drezel]], and sits just outside city limits.

===Spawns===

* A [[gold bar]], a [[gold ore]], a [[ruby ring]], a [[brass necklace]], and 225 [[coins]] spawn in the basement of the Varrock west bank.
* 2 [[bucket]]s spawn on the second floor of the [[Varrock Castle]], and a [[pie dish]] spawns in the castle kitchen.
* A [[leather body]] spawns in the building next to [[Aubury's Rune Shop]], and a [[jug]] spawns by the nearby [[tea seller]].
* 6 [[logs]] can be found in Varrock, four in the [[sawmill]] and two in the [[Daddy's Home]] building.
* A [[pot]]  spawns in the back of the [[Blue Moon Inn]], a [[thread]] kitchen of the [[Jolly Boar Inn]], and a [[body rune]] spawns just outside the eastern entrance to the [[Grand Exchange]]
